events.title: 2027 Brickies Creation Festival — Free Family LEGO Building Competition and Hands-On Zones
events.location: Old Town Square, Fort Collins, Colorado, USA
events.cost: Free admission and activities for participants and spectators; family of five $0, optional vendor purchases extra.
events.age: All ages welcome as spectators; 2027 competition age and team rules not yet confirmed; separate registration needed to compete.
events.description: Official 2027 event lists games, four-hour LEGO building competition, building zones, LEGO art stations, displays and giveaways, not a routine paid class. Organizers say participation and spectator entry are free. Competition registration opens May 3, 2027 at 9 AM local, per https://www.brickiescreationfestival.com/registration; 2027 category capacity/rules need verification closer to opening. July date falls within 2027–28 family residence.

events.title: Greeley Festival of Trees — Limited-Date Horse-Drawn Wagon Rides Around Illuminated Lincoln Park
events.time: ONLY Saturday November 28 and Friday December 4, 2026, 5:00–8:00 PM MST each day (not daily)
events.location: Union Colony Civic Center box office (701 10th Ave) and Lincoln Park, Greeley, Colorado, USA
events.cost: Horse-drawn wagon ride $5 per person, family of five $25; optional separate indoor Festival of Trees admission $5 per adult and $3 per child age 12 or under (five people $19) at box office, or $44 for both.
events.age: Public family activity, no age or residency restriction specified; simultaneous seating of all five not guaranteed.
events.description: The City of Greeley advertises actual horse-and-wagon rides around illuminated Lincoln Park on only two 2026 evenings; tickets for the ride are available IN PERSON ONLY at the Union Colony Civic Center box office, $5 each. Distinct from previously submitted Wheat Ridge and Highlands Ranch free carriage events; relevant to 2026 local contacts, not the 2027–28 family stay.
